task.description:
Produce design artefact for ENV-04 (Stage 14 frontend test-tenant UI labelling). Read: docs/requirements/ENV-04.md. Classify using templates/lego-catalog.md. Produce src/design/tenant-env-ui.md (Type E prose) covering: persistent TEST ENVIRONMENT banner (yellow, fixed top), paired production tenant name in banner, [TEST] suffix in tenant switcher, Promote to Production button on ProcessDefinition detail (test tenant + ACTIVE only), confirmation modal for promotion action. No implementation code in design.

REWORK 1 — Fix: add coverage for ENV-04 AC5 (Instance list isolation). Add a prose statement to src/design/tenant-env-ui.md clarifying that Instance list isolation for test tenants is handled at the API/backend level (each API call is scoped to the active tenant via JWT claim + tenant context middleware), so no frontend filtering is required. This satisfies the acceptance criterion without introducing frontend code that duplicates backend enforcement.

result.summary: Design for tenant-env-ui (ENV-04) — Type E prose. Rework 1: added §9 Instance List Isolation covering ENV-04 AC5. Backend (TNT-03 search_path + JWT tenant context middleware) enforces instance isolation; no frontend filtering required. Lint passes.
